payload.title: Recover seven event exports and make render queue window-independent
acceptance: Preserve active session0151 render and identify seven current jobs without duplicating completed outputs.
Fix Add to Render Queue to reuse one queue window, and make render ownership independent from closing its UI or implement a robust persistent worker.
Resume/retry remaining six jobs with captured settings/snapshots and verify all seven output files.
Add meaningful regression coverage and verify canonical queue state and UI behavior.
